products.product_description: Macaroni and cheese packaged in plastic bags, 12 oz. to a bag, and sold under the Sweet Street Desserts brand. Cases of product contain 36 bags for a total case weight of 27 lbs.
products.reason_for_recall: Mac & Cheese Shells (Product Code B254A1) sold under the Sweet Street Desserts brand in 12 oz. plastic bags is being recalled due to the presence of Listeria monocytogenes.
